# Bhagavat Gita in Telugu

> The Bhagavad Gita (literally "Song of God") is a 700-verse Sanskrit Hindu script

The Bhagavad Gita (literally "Song of God") is a 700-verse Sanskrit Hindu scripture divided into 18 chapters, forming part of the epic poem Mahabharata. It is set as a dialogue between the warrior prince Arjuna and his guide, Krishna, on the Kurukshetra battlefield just before a major war
